purpose: Prevent duplicate CardNest Season One art generation and accidental upload of non-canonical contact sheets.
rules: Before generating any image, cross-check cardNumber, id, name, theme, creatureType, rarity, battleClass, battleClassIconKey and stats against data/season-one.json.
Before generating a batch, confirm the target cards do not already have production-ready full-card assets in public/cards/season-01/NNN/.
Contact sheets are reference-only unless every card's canonical name, rarity, class and stats are verified.
Do not count a contact sheet as a completed production card.
Do not upload rejected or reference-only sheets as individual website card assets.
Cards #001-#011 are visual composition references; canonical taxonomy overrides any legacy wording or badge error visible in those images.
Card #068 has source artwork but still needs a canonical full-card render.

Generated contact sheet used non-canonical card names/rarities; must not be uploaded as production art.
Concept art exists, but generated card text/stats are not canonical; do not use as final production cards.
Earlier generation attempts produced non-canonical names/metadata; rejected and not production assets.
